correctness.rationale: For paths, disjoint closed neighborhoods require successive selected indices at least three apart; isolation means every internal undominated run has at most one vertex, so successive gaps are at most four, with initial and final slack at most two. For cycles the same argument is cyclic, and the k=1 boundary is exactly orders three and four. The path slack/gap words and marked cyclic compositions bijectively count every admissible set, yielding both rational generating functions. Componentwise independence proves multiplicativity and the unique C5 obstruction. A direct bitmask verifier checked connected paths and cycles through order seventeen plus every disconnected component profile through order nine, 221 graphs and 577328 subsets; all coefficients agree. These computations are corroboration, not the proof.

originality.rationale: The complete June 2026 initiating paper was inspected: it proves existence for trees and names C5 as an obstruction, but does not classify/count all packing-isolating sets of paths, cycles or maximum-degree-two graphs. The closest other full-text theorem on cycle packing-dominating sets permits cyclic gaps 3,4,5 at d=p=2, not our isolation-mandated gaps 3,4; even existence differs on C5. published-finding corpus plus both current and prior owned ledgers were searched under invariant and graph-family aliases. No covering structural/enumerative result was located; residual alternate-terminology risk remains.
residual_risks: A path/cycle enumeration of simultaneous packing and edge isolation under older terminology might be poorly indexed.
The result is a complete natural low-degree classification, not a claim about subcubic graphs or higher-degree obstructions.
Published-record searches cannot prove global uniqueness.

value.rationale: The 2026 primary paper raises the natural question of simultaneous packing and isolation, proving universal existence on trees but explicitly excluding C5 in general. The theorem closes the complete first nonforest degree class: C5 is the unique connected obstruction when maximum degree is at most two, and the two rational bivariate generating functions count every solution by size, including disconnected graphs. The exact gap characterization and contiguous size spectra distinguish this stricter invariant from distance-two packing domination, so this is a motivated complete classification rather than a scalar classroom calculation.
